### Headline summary
- A widespread Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook, Teams, and government email services globally. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/microsoft-365-global-outage-outlook-teams-ai-services?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/11/worldwide-microsoft-365-outage-disrupts-outlook-sharepoint-teams-and-more), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/microsoft-struggles-to-restore-email-and-other-services-in-a-global-outage/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/massive-microsoft-365-outage/))
- Citrix released patches for ten critical NetScaler vulnerabilities that could lead to denial-of-service conditions. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/citrix-patches-10-critical-netscaler-vulnerabilities/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/citrix-patches-netscaler-security-vulnerabilities/))
- International law enforcement disrupted the Gootloader malware operation, which was linked to 44 ransomware attacks and 25,000 infected computers. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/gootloader-ransomware-doj-details), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202997/cyber-crime/gootloader-malware-disrupted-after-infecting-25000-computers.html))

### Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/microsoft-365-global-outage-outlook-teams-ai-services?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [Malwarebytes Labs (Vendor)](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/11/worldwide-microsoft-365-outage-disrupts-outlook-sharepoint-teams-and-more))

### Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities
Successful exploitation could lead to unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/citrix-patches-10-critical-netscaler-vulnerabilities/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/citrix-patches-netscaler-security-vulnerabilities/))

### DOJ: Gootloader used in at least 44 ransomware attacks costing $29 million since 2018
In a briefing adjacent to European announcements about an international anti-malware operation, U.S. officials detailed the history and impact of the Gootloader ransomware. ([The Record](https://therecord.media/gootloader-ransomware-doj-details))

### Gootloader Malware Disrupted After Infecting 25,000 Computers
International law enforcement disrupts Gootloader, seizing domains and taking down over 100 servers linked to 25,000 infected computers. The U.S. ([Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202997/cyber-crime/gootloader-malware-disrupted-after-infecting-25000-computers.html))

### FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has established that threat actors tied to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK aka North Korea) have stolen more than $400 million worth of cryptocurrency as part of a social engineering scheme codenamed FaceStealer in the last 18 months. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/fbi-says-north-korean-hackers-stole.html))

### Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/check-point-gateways-hacked-via-php2shell-to-deploy-vmware-esxi-wiper/))

### New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
Two attacks made public this week allow a malicious host to read data inside AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines (VMs), which are built to keep the server's operator out. One of them, Mior, can also modify a VM's memory and fake the signed report confirming which software it runs. ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-mior-and-skyfall-attacks-let-rogue.html))

### Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
Three Trezor Safe 5 wallets bought from the reseller CryptoBilis contain an implant, an extra circuit board that can copy their recovery phrases, hardware wallet maker Trezor said yesterday.
